The '''H-60 Tempest bomber''',<ref name="SWCL" /> sometimes nicknamed '''B-wing''',<ref name="BI">[[Black Ice (adventure)|''Black Ice'']]</ref> was a flying wing-style [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] that was a predecessor of the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]].<ref name="TFUCG" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:YavinHotRodGarage-ITW.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Two H-60s in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi temple]] hangar (bottom left corner, and top right corner) with one cockpit detached.]]
The Tempest resembled a larger version of the later B-wing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], but lacked its folding wings. There was also a different engine configuration than that of the B-wing, and other design variations, including a cockpit on each end which were detachable for maintenance and repairs.<ref name="SWCL" />

It cost 172,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], had medium [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], twin light [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], and a ventral [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]] bay.<ref name="Target" />

==History==
The H-60 bomber was developed for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] in the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Naval planners held a dislike for the resource-heavy and unusual twin-cockpit design and the bombers saw little use. Some were stored in Republic scrap yards to be used for spare parts.<ref name="TFUCG" />

[[File:H-60_Tempest_appearance.jpg|thumb|left|220px|A [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] and a H-60 Tempest attacking a [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] during the [[Battle for Black Ice|Battle for ''Black Ice'']].]]
As the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power, bombers were sold off to independent parties in secret and saw some moderate success for several decades.<ref name="TFUCG" /> Only a few [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] worth had been made when the line was scuttled, with the Rebel Alliance purchasing several of them at a drastic discount, being used in conflicts at the Outer Rim.<ref name="Target" />

Although the design was too inflexible to compete with more modern fighters, the best parts of the H-60 were used in the design of the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]].<ref name="TFUCG" /> Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the H-60 was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], with some ships from [[Ord Bueri/Legends|Ord Bueri]] kept in reserve at their main base on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]].<ref name="SWCL" /> H-60 Tempest bombers were used by Rebel forces during the [[Battle for Black Ice|Battle for ''Black Ice'']].<ref name="BI" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:H-60_Tempest.jpg|150px|thumb|Discarded [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']] concept art that looks similar to the H-60 Tempest.]]
[[Leland Chee]] has said that a craft that resembles a B-wing in the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Droids'']] episodes "[[Escape Into Terror]]" and "[[The New King]]" may be the H-60 Tempest bomber.<ref name="LC">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=980#15895005|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-11-06|time=6:03 PM|quote=Droids animated series B-wing: Likely, it's some sort of predecessor like the H-60 Tempest bomber.}}</ref>

Although the ''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]'' says the craft has a crew of four, [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']] says it only has two; a pilot and gunner.
